summary: No qualifying comparable sales were found. All 20 base records fail at least one screen. Seven Dallas industrial sales that otherwise met the date window, 8-mile radius, 71,500-159,500 sf band, fee-simple/single-asset/stabilized/unrelated tests and had known positive consideration (R8490, R2607 and its duplicate R6997, R9929, R8382, R7274, R7218, R4189) were excluded because executed amendments published and effective 2026-08-20 relocate those entities to the Seattle market, which overrides the base extract. The remainder fail on asset type (R8252 Office), size band (R8993 at 231,000 sf), size unit (R3387 in acres), unknown consideration (R8114 null), unallocated portfolio pricing (R2188), minority interest (R8402), related party (R9726), redevelopment condition (R8181), listing status (R3099), out-of-window closing (R2942 in 2024), distance (R2939 at 18.6 mi) and post-cutoff publication (R7726, published 2026-09-03). R2607/R6997 are duplicates of entity FIR-SAL-95060 and would have consumed only one slot. The delivered comp-grid XLSX (artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx) shows zero comps plus a full record-level screening log with source citations; the qualified-comp count formula returns 0.
limitations: The 2026-08-20 executed amendments restate only market; read as controlling entity-level attributes they eliminate every otherwise-qualifying Dallas industrial comp. If those amendments were intended to apply narrowly or prospectively, the result would change materially.

U-R8490-2 (consideration restated to $1) and S-R7726 are dated after the 2026-08-31 cutoff and were excluded as later-dated evidence; R7726 is the nearest miss since only its publication date disqualifies it.
R8114 consideration is missing rather than zero, so a real price may exist but is not evidenced.
R3387 may be 114,400 sf mis-unitized as acres, but no corrected evidence was supplied, so it cannot be normalized.
No cap rate, NOI, buyer/seller identity or submarket detail is supplied, so arm's-length pricing and qualitative adjustments could not be verified beyond the provided flags.
Distance values and the subject reference point are taken as given in the extracts and are not independently verifiable.
Price per sf was not reported for any selected row because no row qualified; reference math on non-qualifying records is illustrative only.
